select r.id, r.room_number, r.room_type, r.status, coalesce(p.price, case r.room_type when 0 then 199 when 1 then 299 when 2 then 499 end) as price, c.checkin_time, c.checkout_time, i.id as individual_id, i.name as individual_name, i.phone as individual_phone, i.id_card_number as individual_id_card_number from room r left join price_calendar p on p.room_type = r.room_type and p.date = DATE(#{now}) and p.is_deleted = 0 left join ( select room_id, min(id) as id from room_order where is_deleted = 0 and checkin_time < DATE(#{now}) + INTERVAL 1 DAY and checkout_time >= DATE(#{now}) group by room_id ) today on today.room_id = r.id left join room_order o on o.id = today.id left join room_order c on c.room_id = r.id and r.status = 1 and c.status = 0 and c.is_deleted = 0 and (c.pay_status = 1 or c.user_id is null) and c.checkin_time <= #{now} and c.checkout_time > #{now} left join individual i on i.id = o.individual_id where r.is_deleted = 0 order by r.id
